name: Sleduj za chjornym kotikom
source:
You buy a laptop with your hands. You find an interactive collection of short stories on your laptop and something else. Or someone? What will all this lead to?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805390/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你用双手购买笔记本电脑。你会在笔记本电脑和其他东西上找到交互式短篇故事集。或者某人？这一切将导致什么？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805390/]Steam[/url]]
